# defectdojo_regulation (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo regulation, such as PCI DSS or HIPAA, which products list in `regulation_ids`. DefectDojo comes with 26 regulations; look them up with the `defectdojo_regulation` data source.

~> **Destroying a regulation removes it from every product** that lists it. The `regulation_ids` of a `defectdojo_product` that listed it then show a change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_regulation" "nis2" {
  name         = "Network and Information Security Directive 2"
  acronym      = "NIS2"
  category     = "security"
  jurisdiction = "European Union"
  description  = "Cybersecurity obligations for essential and important entities."
  reference    = "https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2022/2555/oj"
}

# Products list regulations by ID: a managed one, and one DefectDojo comes with.
data "defectdojo_regulation" "pci" {
  acronym = "PCI DSS"
}

resource "defectdojo_product" "shop" {
  name            = "Web Shop"
  description     = "The customer-facing web shop"
  product_type_id = 4
  regulation_ids  = [defectdojo_regulation.nis2.id, data.defectdojo_regulation.pci.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acronym` (String) The acronym of the regulation, such as `GDPR`, unique across all regulations, compared case-sensitively. At most 20 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `category` (String) The subject of the regulation: one of `privacy`, `finance`, `education`, `medical`, `corporate`, `security`, `government` and `other`.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The territory the regulation applies to, such as `European Union`. At most 64 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.
- `name` (String) The name of the regulation, unique across all regulations, compared case-sensitively. At most 128 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The purpose of the regulation, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. Trim heredocs with `chomp()` or `trimspace()`.
- `reference` (String) An http, https, ftp or ftps URL with more information, at most 200 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the regulation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_regulation.example
  identity = {
    id = 27
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the regulation

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Regulations are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_regulation.example <id>
```
